Plan-repair ledger — 2026-09-05

Audited and repaired exactly the four smallest eligible direct children of fruity-conclusive-goral, ordered by file-impact count then alias. Immutable prose basis: origin/main@d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1. A scoped comparison through origin/main@9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45 found no changes to any of the 37 selected paths; the clean audit worktree remains at 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396 with matching blobs.

- nonsecular-curbable-whelp (0de5-a3e5-577a-45aa): 8 files, 24 editable blocks. Expanded module-only ranges to the omitted canonical-key, dedup-isolation/client/test/seam, pagination fixture/JQL, split-query, truncation, and unmapped-status anchors; replaced obsolete RED/pre-fix claims with current implemented contracts.
- prideful-floggable-porcupine (ae8d-0881-2ccc-4815): 8 files, 44 editable blocks. Added the omitted 40–191-word parent-clear/drop/suppression and stale-snapshot fixture/test docstrings while excluding concise helpers and navigation comments.
- rapid-germless-minibeast (dc69-1fff-2799-46ca): 10 files, 45 editable blocks. Added omitted 404, impossible-link, peer-confirmation, synced-fields, and transition helper/test docstrings plus the two secret-safe subprocess-environment comments.
- contrived-agrarian-flies (31ae-88ad-5935-4adc): 11 files, 50 editable blocks. Removed all nine short status-annotation C-heading false positives; added the real deferred-filing, FIFO-cap, no-rebar-id matrix/guard, reducer, dict/status-preflight, annotation, and REST-transition prose. The concise one-line conflict-resolver test docstrings remain out of scope.

For each leaf, MCP edit_ticket replaced the description, set_file_impact replaced every generic reason with an anchored contract-specific reason, and set_verify_commands recorded exactly seven DD rows: semantic, directives, paths, diff, hygiene, focused, full (12 tracker writes total). Every plan now requires the d49fea41 normalized type_comments=True AST comparison, separate exact directive text/attachment guard, runtime-string identity, one-commit HEAD^..HEAD path equality, path-scoped diff/hygiene checks, pytest over every impacted file, no-timeout worktree-venv make verify, and a non-author one-row-per-block TSV with full-SHA citations and both verdicts PASS.

MCP readback matched all four descriptions, all 37 path/reason rows, and all 28 command rows exactly. Description lengths are 6107/6366/7078/7111 characters; no admission or cross-session warning occurred. All four leaves remain open, unassigned, and unsigned. No code edit, claim, plan review, test gate, transition, close, commit, or manual push was performed; only normal MCP ticket-event auto-pushes occurred.
